items.title: Every factual claim is sourced
items.description: Stats, results, testimonials, awards, service areas and years in business all trace back to the old site or the client. Anything invented is removed.

items.title: No collapsed links
items.description: No page has more than 3 differently-worded links that all point at the same index page (cards that "just reload").

items.title: No empty links
items.description: No <a href=""> anywhere.

items.title: No asset URLs used as page links
items.description: Navigation and "related" links never point at images, PDFs or other files.

items.title: Imported content is styled
items.description: Blog and CPT body content (headings, lists, links, images) renders with the site styles, not as an unstyled wall.

items.title: No duplicate images in content
items.description: The same image does not appear twice in one page body.

items.title: No stale navigation
items.description: Menus, footer and body copy only mention services and pages that still exist.

items.title: Hidden content stays hidden
items.description: Content that must be draft or noindex is not published.

items.title: No junk posts or slug collisions
items.description: No hello-world, sample page, imported listing pages, or posts whose slug matches a page.

items.title: Exposed email addresses reviewed
items.description: Every email address shown on the site is intended (lists each address and where it appears).

items.title: No buried mu-plugin overrides
items.description: Custom mu-plugins are listed; none force styles, redirects or filters that shadow the theme.

items.title: Display titles are clean
items.description: On-page H1s are not long SEO strings (over 70 characters or containing " | ").

items.title: Alt text on content images
items.description: Content images have alt text; decorative ones are counted separately.

items.title: One phone format
items.description: Phone numbers use one consistent format sitewide.

items.title: Everything rendered is editable
items.description: Every visible section can be edited in wp-admin (ACF field, CPT, Theme Options).

items.title: CPT posts have featured images
items.description: Every published custom-post-type entry has a featured image.

items.title: Yoast title suffix
items.description: Page titles end with the site name via Yoast (separator + %%sitename%%).

items.title: No placeholder leaks
items.description: No fake phones (555, 000), placeholder emails, zero counters, lorem/TBD/TODO or unrendered {{tokens}} on any page.

items.title: Shared rules not trapped in page styles
items.description: Count of page-local <style> blocks per template, so a shared rule living in one template is visible.

items.title: Every page type looked at
items.description: Every distinct page type was opened and looked at on desktop and phone (QA Swarm screenshots help).
